Template and copy changes need her sign-off before merge.","criticality":0.5,"epistemic":"fact","id":"01a1072d-3607-7ba1-ba6e-bfb5895a6435","invalidated_at":"2026-10-04T13:49:29.598236566Z","logical":["notifier"],"physical":["services/notifier/"],"provenance":"human","status":"challenged","summary":"Who owns the notifier","superseded_by":"01a1072d-430c-77a3-b4f9-576373b4789b","tags":["notifier","ownership"],"type":"context","visibility":"shared"}}

Any engineer on the Growth team can sign off. The notifier moved to Growth on 2026-09-01, and template and copy changes are now approved in **#growth-eng**.

An older project note still said Dana Okafor owns the notifier and has to approve copy changes. That's out of date: Dana moved to Platform when Growth took over. I flagged that note as superseded so it won't come up again. Nothing in the repo itself, such as a CODEOWNERS file, names an approver, so these notes are the only source.

Also, when you edit the receipt email, change both `services/notifier/templates/<event>.mjml` and its plain-text twin `<event>.txt`. The two need to keep the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
